raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fix HY-V4 checkpoint-backed learnable sink loading in NVIDIA target/MTP and AMD target models. The AMD target path was omitted from the original series and is included here.

The runtime parameter already has local TP shape. `load_weights` takes the rank slice once and passes it to the parameter's current `weight_loader`; no padded helper or second sharding loader is needed. The AMD and NVIDIA target paths preserve their TP slicing, load the local shard through the current `weight_loader`, and use the same shared `loaded_params` path.

## Validation

- This PR changes only three HY-V4 files. `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `git diff --check` pass.
- Static validation on the integrated final tree: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `git diff --check`, and test tethering pass. The source audit passes 28 tests. The new runtime tests have not been executed, as requested.

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used.

﻿## Verification on H20

**Verified commit:** `69031c5a1480db8eeb8eb1993befdc8a864c56a7` (this PR's head; it covers 3 HY-V4 call sites (amd/nvidia target, nvidia mtp))
**Integration commit:** `c623df9e4bfe1133a3205b94e2d771ba43876ec7` (`attn-sink-integration` = #57797 + #57798 + #57801 + #57803 + #57804 + #57805 + #57806)
### Environment

- Cluster: H20 Slurm, node `vllm-h20-01`, 1x NVIDIA H20-3e (`--partition=h20 --gres=gpu:h20:1`)
- Python: `$HOME/vllm-shared/prebuilt-venv/bin/python` (torch 2.13.0+cu130 + compiled vllm from the shared prebuilt baseline)
- Pure-Python change, so the verified revision was overlaid onto the prebuilt package with `make-overlay.sh`; nothing was recompiled.

### Results

| Suite | Where | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_attention_sink_load_audit.py` (from #57806) | head node + GPU node | 39 passed |
| `test_attn_sink_reload.py` (from #57797) | head node (CPU) | 18 passed, 2 skipped (CUDA-only) |
| `test_attn_sink_reload.py` | H20 GPU | **20 passed** |
| GPU end-to-end sink reload script | H20 GPU | **8/8 checks passed** |

The GPU script drives a real layerwise reload (`record_metadata_for_reloading` -> `initialize_layerwise_reload` -> `load_weights` -> `finalize_layerwise_reload`) on CUDA tensors and asserts the live update lands in the kernel tensor storage with the `-inf` padding tail re-established and the storage pointer unchanged:

```text
PASS  live update reaches kernel tensor
PASS  live update re-establishes -inf padding
PASS  kernel tensor storage is stable
PASS  rank 1 live update loads its own heads
ALL GPU SINK CHECKS PASSED
```

### Pre-commit

```text
pre-commit run --files <changed files>
pass1 rc=0 dirty=0
pass2 rc=0 dirty=0
```

No hook rewrote a file. `run-precommit.sh` skips the `pip-compile` hooks because the sandbox cannot reach PyPI; no requirements file is touched here.

### Not verified

- No full-model checkpoint was loaded (no matching weights available), so this is loader/contract-level plus a real GPU reload, not a full-model accuracy run.
- Single GPU; TP>1 was exercised in-process via distinct rank head ranges, not as a multi-process TP run.

### What changed in this revision

- The AMD and NVIDIA target sink branches still fell through into the generic weight-remapping code after loading the sink. They now `continue`, matching the MTP branch.
- Both target branches also now add the sink to `loaded_params`, so callers that validate "all parameters loaded" see the truth. The MTP branch already did.
- All three sites use the shared `load_padded_attn_sink` helper instead of a second copy of the inline loader lookup. HY-V4's parameter already has the local head shape, so the helper's padding path is a no-op there.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
